activity.notes: John III Sobieski was elected king in 1674 and ruled the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth until his death in 1696. This Activity records his sovereign kingship of the Commonwealth at year granularity.

sources.title: Discover the Royal Residence — Museum of King Jan III's Palace at Wilanów
sources.citation_text: The Museum of King Jan III's Palace identifies Jan Sobieski (1629-1696) and states that his victory at Khotyn in 1673 led to his election as king of Poland the following year.

sources.title: Jan III Sobieski of the Janina coat of arms — Museum of King Jan III's Palace at Wilanów
sources.citation_text: The Wilanów museum account dates Sobieski's royal election to May 1674 and documents his rule in the Commonwealth.
